visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man seen from an over-the-shoulder perspective wearing a black long-sleeved shirt and a camouflage-patterned vest with yellow ear protection. He aims a silver handgun at a target in a brightly lit indoor shooting range lane and fires, causing a visible muzzle flash. (2) The scene cuts to the front entrance of the 'KOREA SHOOTING CLUB' in Myeong-dong, featuring glass doors adorned with various movie posters and weapon-related graphics. The camera pans slightly to show the bright interior reception area with a yellow counter. (3) Inside the reception area, a staff member is visible behind the counter while the camera captures the walls decorated with framed firearms and information boards. The environment is clean with a reflective floor and bright overhead lighting. (4) A montage sequence shows the man firing different weapons, including a black rifle with a red dot sight and various handguns. The lane dividers are clear glass, allowing a view of the target area. (5) The man stands in a lobby area, holding and flipping through several large paper targets with heart shapes, character drawings, and bullet hole clusters. He points at the center of the targets while gesturing with his hands during a conversation.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 韓國實彈射擊. (2) [Logo]: KOREA SHOOTING CLUB. (3) [Subtitle]: 我們今天來韓國首爾明洞來做實彈射擊. (4) [Subtitle]: 現場有很多價格組合可以選. (5) [Subtitle]: 我們這次選擇的是總共五把槍. (6) [Subtitle]: 每把槍十發子彈. (7) [Subtitle]: 總共50發子彈套餐. (8) [Subtitle]: 然後這個費用大概是2萬韓幣. (9) [Subtitle]: 順著台幣大概是差不多5000塊台幣左右. (10) [Subtitle]: 這個套餐費的話. (11) [Subtitle]: 四把都是手槍. (12) [Subtitle]: 有一把衝鋒槍. (13) [Subtitle]: 但是衝鋒槍有內紅點哦. (14) [Subtitle]: 不過我覺得他的火藥裝藥量應該不是全裝的. (15) [Subtitle]: 他感覺威力比印象中的小了一點. (16) [Subtitle]: 但這也是大部分觀光射擊場都有的問題. (17) [Subtitle]: 他們想要節省火藥量. (18) [Subtitle]: 減少槍支的損耗. (19) [Subtitle]: 成績揭曉. (20) [Subtitle]: 99分. (21) [Subtitle]: 為什麼99都在那個洞啊. (22) [Subtitle]: 100分. (23) [Subtitle]: 爆頭100分. (24) [Subtitle]: 我覺得他的槍目前都還調的都不錯. (25) [Subtitle]: 我去過的都不好的槍. (26) [Subtitle]: 每支都偏很多的. (27) [Subtitle]: 然後他有一把衝鋒槍. (28) [Subtitle]: 有內紅點的效果蠻準的. (29) [Subtitle]: 但他打的距離都很近. (30) [Subtitle]: 大概那個距離應該是有打到56米而已. (31) [Subtitle]: 我覺得他打的很近. (32) [Subtitle]: 他最遠那個靶場應該也有十幾20米吧. (33) [Subtitle]: 我覺得再打一次我反而會打遠的. (34) [Subtitle]: 因為這個太容易.

The narrator continues detailing the shooting package prices and options with a professional narrative inflection. (3) Rapid sequences of mechanical clicks and loud percussive bursts follow as various firearms are discharged. The BGM remains consistent with a mid-tempo synth beat. (4) A female voice laughing and commenting enters the background, creating a casual, cheerful atmosphere. The sound of paper rustling and light thuds is prominent as targets are flipped. (5) The male narrator's voice becomes more technical as he reviews his performance. The video ends with a mix of conversational chatter, paper handling noises, and the steady BGM track.
